P-R1.what: Creating a portfolio for a user who has none
P-R1.why: Creating a profile and a portfolio is the first-run flow of the Settings ticket.

P-O1.what: The Optimizer tab and its Available to trade box still show the retired suggestions model
P-O1.why: The optimizer's stored proposals replace it in the Optimizer ticket; this page does not touch that tab.

P-D1.what: Return against the benchmark fund is unavailable while the fund has no price history
P-D1.why: The report says so (performance.fund.available is false with a reason); the fund's price history is a backend data job.

P-D2.what: The change at the last close may include cash the owner added or took out that day
P-D2.why: The value history does not say how much cash moved each day; net_flow_cad is requested from the backend. Until then the figure is flagged when the cost base or cash changed between the two days.

P-W4.why: The ledger never overwrites and has no route that sets a position's shares and average cost. A mistake is fixed with Correct or Reverse in Transactions; setting the figures directly needs a backend route (handoff for 86bd6r34c).

P-C1.what: The currency of a holding's realised gain is not stated by the API
P-C1.why: HoldingResponse.total_realized_gain_loss has no currency in its description; it is shown in the stock's currency.

P-C2.what: A closed position's realised percent is unavailable
P-C2.why: Holdings carry the realised amount but no percent and no CAD amount.

P-A1.what: Allocation by geography is replaced by allocation by currency
P-A1.why: The API has no country for a stock; exposure reports currency.

P-A2.what: Allocation for a single account (TFSA, RRSP or Trading)
P-A2.why: The exposure report has no account filter yet; until it has, the sector, industry and currency donuts say they cover the whole portfolio.

P-H1.what: The numeric Bull and Bear disagreement score is not shown
P-H1.why: The snapshot serves the disagreement class (consensus, mild dissent, split decision, high conflict), not the score.

P-H2.what: The change in price over the day is derived, not served
P-H2.why: The snapshot gives the change as a fraction; the amount is the price less price / (1 + change).

P-H3.what: Dividend per share is the analysis's expected income over its horizon, not the last year's payments
P-H3.why: The snapshot serves income_per_share from the price band; the old annual_dividend_per_share has no source.

P-H5.what: A holding's note can be read but not edited
P-H5.why: No route changes a holding's notes.

P-F1.what: The report's per-stock lines, who-and-why, breakdowns and action list are not shown
P-F1.why: Holdings and Transactions already carry the same per-holding and per-action figures; a Reports view is a separate feature.

P-F2.what: The tax-year refund block of the report is not shown
P-F2.why: It is an untyped record in the API.

P-T1.why: The API serves reverses_transaction_id on the reversing row only, so the page marks a reversed row only when its reversing row is on the loaded page.

P-W10.what: The entry preview's tax, room and gain figures are untyped
P-W10.why: The preview serves row, estimated_tax and room as untyped objects, so the page reads them by their documented keys: marginal_rate is a whole percent (31.48, no unit marker protects it) and a sale at a loss returns a negative estimated_tax, shown as a saving. Typed models with unit markers are a backend follow-up.

P-W11.what: Recording an RRSP contribution for the previous tax year (January and February)
P-W11.why: The form does not send tax_year, so a contribution counts for the year of its date; the API allows the prior year during the first 60 days.

P-W12.what: Marking a trade as following an optimizer proposal
P-W12.why: recommendation_id is not sent: proposals are shown by the Optimizer ticket, which links a trade to the proposal it follows.

E-1.what: Mock mode cannot reproduce server-side filtering and paging, so the Transactions filter flows are not tested end to end
E-1.why: A recorded file is the same for every query. The Transactions filters are covered by the live run (npm run test:e2e:live) against a seeded scratch backend.

P-W9.what: Adding a stock by company name
P-W9.why: The backend lookup (GET /api/stocks/lookup) takes a ticker only, so Add Stock and the Watchlist search by ticker.

P-N1.what: Entering cash by hand: contributions, withdrawals, fees, interest and currency conversions (POST /events). The cash balance is shown read-only
P-N1.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-N2.what: Moving shares in kind between accounts (POST /moves and /moves/preview)
P-N2.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-N3.what: Confirming a position or an account's cash against the broker, and the history of those checks (POST /reconciliation, GET /reconciliations, the confirmations on positions)
P-N3.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built. Not confirming only produces a warning on the backend plans.

P-N4.what: A reason and a note on an entry (reason_code, notes)
P-N4.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-N5.what: The rest of the performance report in the header: estimated tax (capital gains, dividends and interest on the Trading account), fees, profit lines, return per year, the benchmark fund comparison, and money in and out
P-N5.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-N7.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-N8.what: Allocation beyond the three donuts: industry, each company directly and through funds, correlated groups and pairs, risk figures, and the exposure warnings
P-N8.why: The original design has no such screen (owner decision, 2026-11-25). A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

P-H6.what: The Remove icon is shown on every holding
P-H6.why: The original design showed it only for a holding with no transactions (transaction_count). The API serves no transaction count, so the icon is always shown and the server decides (it reverses every entry; NOT_REMOVABLE when it cannot).

W-1.what: Portfolio Fit of a watched stock
W-1.why: Analyses no longer judge fit for a portfolio, so nothing serves it. The column stays and says unavailable (backend handoff BH-13).

W-2.what: The suggested account for a watched stock
W-2.why: The account matrix scores each account but names no suggestion, and choosing one in the browser would be a second rule (backend handoff BH-13).

W-3.what: The numeric Bull and Bear disagreement score and the low, moderate, high labels
W-3.why: The API serves four disagreement classes and no score; the column shows the class.

W-4.what: An analysis of a newly added stock
W-4.why: The weekly batch reads its own list, not the watchlist, and the screen has no control to start one, so a new stock stays "Awaiting analysis" (backend handoff BH-14).

W-5.what: Writing a note on a watched stock (PATCH /api/watchlist/{id})
W-5.why: The original design has no such control. A note that exists is shown in the expanded row.

W-6.what: Starting an analysis from the watchlist (POST /api/analysis and its status)
W-6.why: The original design has no such control. A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

W-7.what: Marking a watched stock that is also held
W-7.why: The original design has no such marker. A candidate for the owner to design; nothing was built.

S-2.what: The Layer 2 portfolio context: fit, suggested action and account note (Stock and Analysis pages)
S-2.why: Analyses are account-neutral, so nothing serves it. The card stays and says unavailable (backend handoff BH-13).

S-3.what: The account of an analysis (history column and Analysis page header)
S-3.why: Analyses are account-neutral; the column and header say unavailable (owner, 2026-11-25).

S-4.what: Running a new analysis from the Stock page
S-4.why: The route exists (POST /api/analysis); the owner chose to leave the button disabled for now (2026-11-25).

S-5.what: Company description, headquarters, employees and website; market cap of Canadian stocks

S-8.what: Whether a past prediction was right
S-8.why: No stored verdict; the history shows whether a checkpoint is resolved and the return (backend handoff BH-17).

S-9.what: Stock, price, fundamentals, run, result and prediction fields with no place in the design
S-9.why: Industry, daily open, high, low and volume, further ratios, the business profile, price-band detail and horizons, agent ratings and interpretive fields, the rest of the CIO record, the shadow call, retired agents, checkpoint detail, the history of failed runs and run versions are served and not shown.

S-6.what: The fundamentals as they were at one analysis
S-6.why: The Analysis page shows the newest stored fundamentals, with the day they are from (backend handoff BH-15).

S-7.what: The signal and the BUY, HOLD or SELL badge of each agent
S-7.why: Agents no longer give them; the agent sections show what they do write (owner, 2026-11-25).

S-10.what: Runs from before the price band, in the history, as a latest call and on the Analysis page
S-10.why: Not loaded or shown (owner, 2026-11-26): no longer informative, and the account-based ones can quote one user's details. A stock whose newest run is one reads as not analysed yet (backend handoff BH-19).

T-2.what: Creating a profile on first run
T-2.why: The original page has no create flow. POST /api/users exists. Creating a portfolio is P-R1.

T-3.what: Change history of a setting, and archiving or restoring a profile
T-3.why: The API serves both (GET /api/history, DELETE and PATCH is_active); the original page has no place for them.

T-5.why: Stored, but nothing in the system reads them, so the table was removed (owner, 2026-11-26).

T-6.why: The profile has no created date (backend handoff BH-22). The line was removed.

T-7.what: Income bracket, experience, risk tolerance, default account and timeline, notes to agents, goals, sector lists, dividend and geographic preference, RRSP strategy, notification toggles, LLM mode and batch schedule
T-7.why: Nothing stores or reads them; removed from the page with its tabs (owner, 2026-11-26). Annual income replaces the bracket.

T-8.what: The optimizer's list of stocks to sell
T-8.why: A trading decision for the Optimizer screen, not a setting (owner, 2026-11-26). Settings keeps the stored list as it is.

T-9.why: Cash waits for deposits and withdrawals (owner, 2026-11-26).
